title: Key Factors for Strong Labour Market Demand for Engineers and Technology Specialists, While PMETs Face Retrenchments
what_it_is: Key Factors for Strong Labour Market Demand for Engineers and Technology Specialists, While PMETs Face Retrenchments

sections.label: Labour market skill mismatches
sections.summary: Shifts in skill requirements drive demand for AI and engineering jobs while PMET roles become easier to automate, leaving retrenched PMETs without needed technical skills.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Mismatches in the labour market may be driven by shifts in skill requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: For example, firms are expanding technology functions, driving sustained demand for jobs like AI engineers and engineering professionals, while restructuring other professional, manager, executive and technician (PMET) roles that have become easier to automate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Retrenched PMETs may lack the specific technical skills and experience to fulfil the requirements in in-demand engineering and technology specialist jobs.

sections.label: PMET vacancies and retrenchments
sections.summary: As of December 2025, the two sectors had 4,100 and 5,300 PMET vacancies, against only 960 PMET retrenchments in the last quarter of 2025.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: As of December 2025, these two sectors had PMET vacancies of 4,100 and 5,300 respectively.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Comparatively, there were only 960 PMET retrenchments across both sectors for the last quarter of 2025.

sections.label: Career Conversion Programmes placements
sections.summary: WSG supports workers reskilling into growth jobs through salary support to employers, placing over 7,300 workers into tech and engineering jobs in three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: To the Member's second point, for the Workforce Singapore (WSG), for the Career Conversion Programmes, we support workers to reskill into growth jobs and into longer-term prospects by provision of salary support to the employers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Over the last three years we have placed over 7,300 workers into tech and engineering related jobs through these Career Conversion Programmes.

sections.label: WSG and higher learning institutes
sections.summary: WSG works closely with institutes of higher learning to ensure courses are industry relevant, especially for professional societies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: In fact, the WSG does work very closely with the institutes of higher learning to make sure that these courses are industry relevant, especially for the professional societies.
